title: Remembering Pratap and Chetak
text: At Moti Magri, the memorial image of Maharana Pratap on Chetak brings the ruler and horse together in the city’s public memory. The site overlooks Fateh Sagar rather than standing at a battlefield. That distinction matters: a memorial tells us how a community chooses to remember history as well as what happened.
